name: replica-id-byte-ordering
description: Two replicas inserting concurrently at the same position, with ids chosen so that any ordering other than unsigned big-endian byte order changes the result.

expected.rationale: PROJECT_SPEC.md section 5: ElementId compares by unsigned big-endian bytes, so 01... precedes ff... and 'a' comes first. Both elements share a left origin (start) and a right origin (end), so Def. 4 condition (3) fixes the answer, making this trace sensitive to the comparator alone. An earlier version of this rationale claimed System.Guid.CompareTo would yield 'ba' here; that is false on .NET 10 and is corrected in section 13.8.
